primary_contrast: concept minus mean of the three per-trial norm-matched random controls
primary_endpoint: mu/beta descriptor MSE change normalized by training variance, averaged over descriptors and then equally over subjects
task_endpoint: subject balanced accuracy change, paired concept minus matched random
off_target_endpoint: occipital alpha/global RMS normalized MSE change
uncertainty: 10000 subject bootstrap samples, seed 193; intervals descriptive, no equivalence claim from nonsignificance
testing: If inferential p-values are reported: enumerate all subject sign flips for directional paired effects, Holm correction across three models times two endpoints (target-loss increase and task-accuracy decrease).
refitting: None; training parameters and validation-selected alpha remain frozen.

exposure.labram: documented EEGMMIDB pretraining exposure; downstream-held-out only

interpretation: Selective descriptor degradation alone is not proof of task dependence; lack of accuracy loss is not proof of independence. Pretraining advantages require random-initialization controls.
